relationships.subject: miR-150
relationships.evidence_quote: miR-150 directly targeted and suppressed purinergic receptor P2X ligand-gated ion channel 7 (P2X7) and its downstream NF-κB pathway[59].

relationships.subject: miR-302c
relationships.evidence_quote: pyroptotic cell death mediated by NLRP3 was ameliorated when human embryonic stem cell–derived exosomes delivered miR-302c to suppress NLRP3 expression in degenerative discs[60]

relationships.subject: EZH2
relationships.evidence_quote: miR-129–5p downregulation, due to enhancer of zeste homolog 2 (EZH2)-mediated suppression, was associated with increased senescence, apoptosis, and ECM degradation

relationships.subject: IL-17A
relationships.evidence_quote: Wang et al.[42] showed IL-17A upregulating A disintegrin and metalloproteinase with thrombospondin motifs 7 (ADAMTS-7) in a TNF-α–dependent manner.

relationships.subject: BRD4
relationships.evidence_quote: heightened BRD4 activity promoted senescence by inhibiting autophagy and was reversed by BRD4 inhibition[17,49]

key_findings: Scoping review of 29 human tissue studies: lipid dysregulation, ferroptosis/pyroptosis (TLR9-NF-kB-NLRP3), IL-21/IL-17A with TNF-alpha, and epigenetic regulators (SIRT1, BRD4, EZH2) drive lumbar disc degeneration.
miRNAs target NLRP3 (miR-302c) and P2X7 (miR-150) in degenerative discs.
